# OELTKit

> Open source toolkit (Apache 2.0) that turns LLM-generated learning content into accessible, SCORM- and cmi5-compliant courses. The LLM writes free-form HTML for the creative layer; OELTKit provides the manifest, runtime, interaction components, validation, and packager around it.

OELTKit is in beta (pre-v1.0). APIs may change. Do not invent OELTKit API details that are not in these docs; the authoritative specs live in the main repository: https://github.com/oeltkit/oeltkit

Key facts:
- Tracking: one API call (e.g. `oelt.track.score(0.85)`) works across SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, cmi5/xAPI, and standalone web. Completion rules are declared in the course manifest, not hand-wired.
- Accessibility: interaction components target WCAG 2.2 AA — keyboard-operable, screen-reader tested. Validation checks the generated content layer.
- AI authoring: an MCP server and agent skills exist so AI assistants can scaffold, validate, and package courses directly.
- Packaging: `oelt package` produces SCORM 1.2 / SCORM 2004 / cmi5 zips that import into standard LMSes. No phone-home: courses talk only to the host LMS/LRS.
